title: G.TYP.06 同一个字典表达式中各个键值不要相同
reason: Constant-evaluable dictionary keys are compared using Python equality/hash semantics; dynamic keys require execution.

title: G.FMT.04 用空格突出关键字和重要信息--取余操作符
reason: Checks both sides of parsed binary modulo operators for separating whitespace; string content and comments are excluded.

title: G.CMT.01 模块文档字符串写在文件的顶部，Shebang和文件编码声明之后，导入(imports) 部分之前的位置，不需要缩进
reason: Requires a module docstring as the first AST statement; shebang and encoding comments may precede it. Empty modules are exempt.

title: G.LOG.01 logging模块应尽量使用懒插值的能力记录debug等低级别日志
reason: Detects eager interpolation for logging module calls and conventional logger/log bindings; arbitrary logger factories and aliases need semantic resolution.

title: G.FMT.04 用空格突出关键字和重要信息--位运算操作符
reason: Checks both sides of parsed binary bitwise operators, including shifts and annotation unions; unary operators, comments and literal contents are excluded.

title: G.CLS.09 重写类的魔法函数时必须返回其原型指定的类型--format
reason: Checks literal/protocol invariants and bounded supplied-source helper return facts, including implicit None, mixed returns and generator protocol mismatches. Dynamic calls, inherited protocols and complete control-flow/type inference remain unsupported.

title: G.LOG.03 禁止直接使用外部数据记录日志
reason: Tracks direct input/request/environment data into logging format arguments within a file; custom sources and interprocedural sanitizers are not modeled.

title: G.PRJ.04 建议同一项目内的编码方式保持一致，推荐使用UTF-8
reason: Validates PEP 263 declarations as UTF-8 including aliases; the CLI reads original bytes as UTF-8 and reports decoding failure as uncovered. UTF-8 BOM is supported without changing input hashes.

title: G.FMT.04 用空格突出关键字和重要信息--算术操作符
reason: Checks both sides of parsed binary arithmetic operators; unary signs and continuation-line whitespace are handled by AST/token positions.

title: G.CMT.03 公共函数的文档字符串写在函数声明(def function_name(param):)所在行的下一行，并向后缩进4个空格
reason: Requires public-function docstrings as the first statement immediately below the terminating declaration colon, indented four spaces; underscore-prefixed functions are private and exempt.

title: G.ERR.06 raise语句必须包含异常实例
reason: Flags directly raised non-exception literals; arbitrary expression types and class-vs-instance intent require type resolution.

title: G.EDV.03 避免在命令解析器中使用通配符
reason: Checks literal wildcard shell command strings and commands assembled via +, f-string, or str.format where a literal fragment contains a glob character; non-literal variable content and helper-call results still require data-flow analysis.

title: G.EXP.03 不应将lambda表达式赋值给变量，应该使用常规函数
reason: Detects assigning lambda expressions to variables, including annotated assignments.

title: G.PSL.02 在datetime的使用过程中注意时区的影响，时区敏感的场景建议显式指定时区
reason: Detects timezone-omitting datetime now/utcnow calls; deciding which business operations are timezone-sensitive needs context.

title: G.CLS.09 重写类的魔法函数时必须返回其原型指定的类型--length_hint
reason: Checks literal/protocol invariants and bounded supplied-source helper return facts, including implicit None, mixed returns and generator protocol mismatches. Dynamic calls, inherited protocols and complete control-flow/type inference remain unsupported.

title: G.IMP.03 避免使用__import__函数
reason: Detects explicit __import__ calls; indirect dynamic dispatch is outside static name-based checking.

title: G.DSP.02 安全场景下必须使用密码学意义上的安全随机数
reason: Flags random module generation as a review candidate; security-sensitive use and wrapper APIs require context.

title: G.TYP.01 需要精确数值计算的场景，应使用decimal模块，且不要用浮点数构造Decimal
reason: Detects Decimal construction from floating-point literals; identifying every precision-sensitive business operation requires context.

title: G.CMT.02 类的文档字符串写在类声明(class ClassName:)所在行的下一行，并向后缩进4个空格
reason: Requires a class docstring as its first statement, exactly one line after the terminating declaration colon and indented four spaces; multiline class headers and decorators are supported.

title: G.NAM.02 命名要有明确含义，以提升代码的可读性
reason: Identifier meaning depends on business vocabulary and cannot be inferred reliably from the exported title; human/AI review must consult domain documentation.

title: G.SER.03 禁止使用yaml模块的load函数
reason: Detects imported yaml.load calls including import aliases; dynamic reassignment of imported symbols is not resolved.

title: G.CTL.02 所有的代码都必须是逻辑可达的
reason: Detects statements after unconditional terminators within one suite; exhaustive control-flow feasibility is not proven.

title: G.EDV.09 禁止直接使用外部数据来拼接XML
reason: Detects direct tainted string concatenation forming XML; template engines and custom sanitizers require interprocedural analysis.

title: G.CLS.09 重写类的魔法函数时必须返回其原型指定的类型--hash
reason: Checks literal/protocol invariants and bounded supplied-source helper return facts, including implicit None, mixed returns and generator protocol mismatches. Dynamic calls, inherited protocols and complete control-flow/type inference remain unsupported.

title: G.PSL.03 修改sys.path时注意避免模块重名问题
reason: Reports sys.path mutations for collision review; actual runtime environment and installed modules are unavailable.

title: G.DSP.03 必须使用ssl.SSLSocket代替socket.Socket来进行安全数据交互
reason: Reports raw socket construction; whether traffic is security-sensitive or subsequently TLS-wrapped requires context.

title: G.TYP.07 使用dict[key]获取 value 时需要注意保证 key 在有效的范围内
reason: Detects missing literal keys in a preceding literal dictionary assignment; alias mutation, branch state and dynamic keys are not proven.

title: G.EDV.10 禁止在处理XML数据时解析不可信的实体
reason: Detects explicit lxml entity enabling and common unsafe XML parsers; parser versions, external trust and custom resolvers require review.

title: G.PRJ.03 产品代码不要包含任何调试入口点
reason: Detects builtin and common pdb/ipdb/debugpy debugging entrypoints; custom entrypoints and production/test deployment boundaries require context.

title: G.VAR.01 禁止在变量的生命周期内修改其类型
reason: Checks successive inferable literal type assignments in lexical scopes; union types, reassignment across branches and aliases require type analysis.

title: G.NAM.01 使用统一的命名风格
reason: Checks function snake_case and class CapWords; exported catalog does not specify all project naming conventions.

title: G.FIO.03 禁止使用tempfile.mktemp创建临时文件
reason: Detects tempfile.mktemp including import aliases; indirect dynamically rebound callables are outside static resolution.

title: G.CTL.01 同一个函数所有分支的返回值类型和个数保持一致
reason: Compares explicit inferable return types and tuple arities; implicit fallthrough and dynamically computed types require control-flow/type analysis.

title: G.CLS.09 重写类的魔法函数时必须返回其原型指定的类型--bytes
reason: Checks literal/protocol invariants and bounded supplied-source helper return facts, including implicit None, mixed returns and generator protocol mismatches. Dynamic calls, inherited protocols and complete control-flow/type inference remain unsupported.

title: G.NAM.04 避免在无关的标识符或无关的概念之间重用名字， 避免因重名而导致的意外赋值和错误引用
reason: Detects overwriting imported identifiers; deciding whether other reuse represents unrelated concepts requires human review.

title: G.CLS.09 重写类的魔法函数时必须返回其原型指定的类型--str
reason: Checks literal/protocol invariants and bounded supplied-source helper return facts, including implicit None, mixed returns and generator protocol mismatches. Dynamic calls, inherited protocols and complete control-flow/type inference remain unsupported.

title: G.SER.04 禁止使用jsonpickle模块的encode/decode或dumps/loads函数
reason: Detects four forbidden jsonpickle APIs including import aliases; indirect dynamic dispatch is not resolved.

title: G.FNM.05 当函数返回值个数较多时，建议通过class/namedtuple/dataclass等具名形式进行封装
reason: Flags tuple returns above three elements as candidates; exported rule provides no threshold or grouping semantics.

title: G.CLS.09 重写类的魔法函数时必须返回其原型指定的类型--repr
reason: Checks literal/protocol invariants and bounded supplied-source helper return facts, including implicit None, mixed returns and generator protocol mismatches. Dynamic calls, inherited protocols and complete control-flow/type inference remain unsupported.

title: G.TES.01 禁止在生产版本的业务代码中使用assert
reason: Detects assertions outside test-like paths; deployment packaging and assertion intent require project configuration.

title: G.VAR.03 禁止覆盖外部作用域中的标识符
reason: Detects direct shadowing of module bindings inside functions; nested closures, class semantics and intentional overrides need review.

title: G.CLS.09 重写类的魔法函数时必须返回其原型指定的类型--index
reason: Checks literal/protocol invariants and bounded supplied-source helper return facts, including implicit None, mixed returns and generator protocol mismatches. Dynamic calls, inherited protocols and complete control-flow/type inference remain unsupported.

title: G.ERR.07 避免抑制或忽略异常
reason: Detects empty/pass-only exception handlers; indirect suppression and intended recovery require control-flow/context analysis.

title: G.CLS.09 重写类的魔法函数时必须返回其原型指定的类型--bool
reason: Checks literal/protocol invariants and bounded supplied-source helper return facts, including implicit None, mixed returns and generator protocol mismatches. Dynamic calls, inherited protocols and complete control-flow/type inference remain unsupported.

title: G.SER.02 禁止序列化未加密的敏感数据
reason: Flags serialization of common sensitive identifiers/keys; sensitivity classification and encryption state require business semantics.

title: G.CTL.03 避免在条件/循环控制语句中包含过多的条件
reason: Flags control conditions with more than five boolean leaves; exported rule provides no numeric complexity threshold.

title: G.CLS.09 重写类的魔法函数时必须返回其原型指定的类型--len
reason: Checks literal/protocol invariants and bounded supplied-source helper return facts, including implicit None, mixed returns and generator protocol mismatches. Dynamic calls, inherited protocols and complete control-flow/type inference remain unsupported.

title: G.LOG.02 使用日志记录工具实现日志功能
reason: Flags print calls outside test-like paths; distinguishing CLI output from logging requires project intent.

title: G.CLS.07 类的方法不需要访问实例时，建议定义为staticmethod或classmethod
reason: Detects instance methods with no self access (including closures) or super call; override and decorator contracts need cross-module type context.

title: G.CLS.09 重写类的魔法函数时必须返回其原型指定的类型--iter
reason: Checks literal/protocol invariants and bounded supplied-source helper return facts, including implicit None, mixed returns and generator protocol mismatches. Dynamic calls, inherited protocols and complete control-flow/type inference remain unsupported.

title: G.ERR.08 禁止通过异常泄露敏感数据
reason: Flags common sensitive identifiers/keys in raised exceptions; complete sensitivity classification requires business context.

title: G.FNM.03 当函数参数个数较多且有相关性时，建议通过class/namedtuple/dataclass等具名形式进行封装
reason: Flags more than five explicit parameters as candidates; parameter relatedness and required grouping are semantic judgments.

title: G.EXP.04 推导式和生成器表达式仅用于简单的逻辑表达
reason: Flags multi-generator/multi-filter comprehensions; rule simplicity has no exported numeric definition.

title: G.NAM.03 “self”应是实例方法的第一个参数，“cls”应是类方法的第一个参数--self
reason: Checks direct class instance methods, excluding staticmethod and __new__; dynamic decorators may change method binding.

title: G.OPR.01 对除法运算和模运算中的除数为0的情况做相应保护
reason: Detects a constant zero divisor; input range proofs and protections require control-flow and interprocedural analysis.

title: G.ERR.14 不要使用return、break、continue或抛出异常使finally块非正常结束
reason: Detects lexical abrupt completion in finally, excluding nested functions and loops contained within finally; exception suppression inside nested handlers requires refined control-flow analysis.

title: G.TES.02 使用对应的方法做值断言
reason: Detects equality comparisons in assertTrue/assertFalse calls; custom test assertion contracts require type context.

title: G.NAM.03 “self”应是实例方法的第一个参数，“cls”应是类方法的第一个参数--没有参数
reason: Checks direct non-static class methods for a receiver parameter; unknown decorators can alter method binding.

title: G.SER.01 禁止使用pickle.load、_pickle.load和shelve模块加载外部数据
reason: Flags pickle/_pickle/shelve loading APIs; external-data trust and validated wrappers require context.

title: G.FNM.04 不要将没有返回值的函数调用结果赋值给变量
reason: Detects assigned results of supplied-source functions with only normal None returns, resolving imports, reexports, local aliases and bounded lexical rebinding. Excludes coroutines, generators, mixed/unknown results and replaced decorators. Dynamic module state, external callees and full call-order analysis remain unsupported.

title: G.FIO.05 构造文件路径时应屏蔽操作系统的差异，建议使用库函数辅助构造
reason: Detects string concatenation with slash separators; path intent and platform contracts require context.

title: G.FIO.01 在多用户系统中创建文件时应根据需要指定合适的权限
reason: Detects explicitly group/world-writable modes on known OS file APIs; effective umask, ACLs, deployment and intended sharing require review.

title: G.CLS.10 未实现的数值运算类型魔法函数必须返回NotImplemented而不是抛出NotImplementedError
reason: Detects NotImplementedError in numeric magic methods; dynamic exception aliases are outside static name resolution.

title: G.ERR.09 在单个except代码块内，禁止重复捕获同类异常
reason: Detects repeated syntactically identical exception classes in a single except tuple; dynamic aliases require type resolution.

title: G.ERR.14 不要使用return、break、continue或抛出异常使finally块非正常结束--不支持finally中的continue
reason: Detects lexical abrupt completion in finally, excluding nested functions and loops contained within finally; exception suppression inside nested handlers requires refined control-flow analysis.

title: G.EDV.02 禁止使用OS命令解析器或“危险函数”调用系统命令
reason: Detects explicit shell parser APIs; custom wrappers and dynamically bound callables require semantic resolution.

title: G.ERR.02 用异常来表示异常，而不是用返回值表示异常
reason: Detects returning constructed Error/Exception objects; integer error codes and application failure contracts require context.

title: G.ERR.04 对异常做类型转换时要保留原始异常的错误调用栈信息
reason: Flags constructing a new exception in except without explicit cause; Python implicit chaining and intended suppression require review.

title: G.TYP.04 建议使用if seq或if not seq的方式判断序列是否为空
reason: Detects len comparisons to zero; variable sequence type and exotic len overloads require type context.

title: G.ERR.03 异常的类型定义必须继承自Exception
reason: Checks Error/Exception-named classes and raised classes against builtin/supplied-source Exception hierarchies. Dynamic exception types, external dependency classes and instance provenance remain unsupported.

title: G.ERR.13 捕获异常后避免直接重新抛出
reason: Detects except suites whose sole statement is a bare re-raise or raising the bound caught-exception variable; changed exception types and handlers performing other work are exempt.

title: G.FMT.10 代码行的行尾结束符LF和CRLF不应该混用
reason: Detects mixed literal LF and CRLF in supplied source text; upstream readers must preserve newlines.

title: G.EDV.01 禁止使用eval和exec函数执行不可信代码
reason: Tracks direct input/request/environment data to eval/exec; custom taint sources, aliases and interprocedural flows remain unsupported.

title: G.FNM.01 禁止使用可变对象作为参数默认值
reason: Detects mutable literal and builtin/container-constructor defaults, matching conventional static dangerous-default checks; dynamic factory mutability is unknowable.

title: G.ERR.05 使用有明确业务属性的异常类型
reason: Detects explicitly raised Exception/BaseException; whether other types have appropriate business meaning needs context.

title: G.FMT.02 行宽不超过120个字符
reason: Uses exported max-line-length option (default 120) and counts Unicode source characters.

title: G.FNM.06 使用return代替StopIteration来结束生成器
reason: Detects explicit StopIteration raises in generator lexical scope; indirect raising calls require interprocedural analysis.

title: G.ERR.10 同时使用多个except语句时，要注意异常捕获的顺序
reason: Resolves builtin and supplied-source exception aliases/inheritance for handler ordering. External dependency types, dynamic exception tuples and path feasibility remain unsupported.

title: G.FNM.02 函数和lambda表达式不应该使用外部的循环代码中定义的变量
reason: Detects loop-variable captures in nested functions/lambdas with default binding exemptions; escape timing and transitive captures require data-flow analysis.

title: G.NAM.05 除了需要重写魔法函数、对象之外，不推荐使用双下划线开头且双下划线结尾的标识符来命名一般对象
reason: Uses a documented magic-name allowlist; Python-version-specific and framework-defined dunders require project configuration.

title: G.TYP.05 对序列使用切片操作时，不建议使用负步进值进行切片
reason: Detects constant negative slice steps in parsed subscripts; dynamically computed values require evaluation.

title: G.FMT.07 导入部分(imports)应该按照标准库、第三方库、应用程序自定义模块的顺序排列导入
reason: Checks standard-library imports before external and relative imports; absolute local-vs-third-party grouping needs a project module index.

title: G.VAR.02 禁止使用global关键字声明不存在的外部变量
reason: Checks global declarations against direct module bindings; conditional definitions, star imports and runtime module injection require context.

title: G.NAM.03 “self”应是实例方法的第一个参数，“cls”应是类方法的第一个参数--cls
reason: Checks explicitly decorated classmethods; aliases or custom decorators require semantic resolution.

title: G.CNP.01 建议为communicate传入超时参数来防止子进程死锁或失去响应
reason: Tracks direct Popen assignment receivers and timeout presence; aliases and interprocedural subprocess wrappers are not resolved.

title: G.FIO.06 解压文件必须进行安全检查
reason: Flags direct tar/zip extraction without tar data filter; size limits, path checks, symlink policy and trust require context.

title: G.CMT.05 正式交付给客户的代码不应包含TODO/FIXME注释
reason: Scans comment tokens only for TODO/FIXME, excluding string literals.

title: G.OPR.02 与None作比较要使用is或is not，不要使用等号
reason: Checks equality/inequality comparisons against None in parsed expressions.

title: G.IMP.02 使用 from ... import ... 语句的注意事项
reason: Checks star imports; other restrictions in this nonspecific exported title are not available.

title: G.EDV.07 不受信任的外部数据禁止使用.format()进行格式化
reason: Tracks direct tainted format receivers; custom sources, sanitizers and interprocedural aliases require data-flow analysis.

title: G.OPR.03 禁止使用is或is not运算符在内置类型之间作比较
reason: Checks identity comparison to non-singleton builtin constants; variable types and cached object identity require type context.

title: G.TYP.08 必须使用isinstance判断变量类型
reason: Checks explicit type() comparisons; indirect aliases and alternative exact-type intent require review.

title: G.EDV.04 禁止使用subprocess模块中的shell=True选项
reason: Detects literal shell=True on imported subprocess APIs; unknown dynamic keyword dictionaries require runtime resolution.

title: G.PSL.01 避免使用已经被标记为弃用并有明确替代的方法
reason: Checks a listed set of deprecated standard-library APIs; complete version-dependent deprecation metadata is not in the export.

title: G.OPR.05 应该使用 is not 运算符而不是not ... is
reason: Checks negated identity comparisons in AST.

title: G.FMT.08 一行只写一条语句
reason: Checks simple statements on the same line as compound control-flow headers.

title: G.EDV.05 调用外部可执行程序时建议使用绝对路径
reason: Checks literal executable paths in direct subprocess/OS launches; dynamic PATH resolution and runtime working directories require context.

title: G.ERR.11 避免使用SystemExit和sys.exit()，主进程入口中例外
reason: Detects SystemExit/sys.exit outside explicit __main__ guards; packaged entrypoints and CLI framework callbacks require project configuration.

title: G.OPR.06 应该使用 not in 测试成员关系
reason: Checks negated membership comparisons in AST.

title: G.FMT.06 每行只能导入一个模块
reason: Detects multiple modules in one import statement.

title: G.EDV.06 禁止直接使用外部数据来拼接SQL语句
reason: Tracks direct tainted SQL concatenation/interpolation to execute-like calls; custom sources, query builders and receiver types require data-flow/type analysis.

title: G.PSL.04 建议用functools.wraps定义函数装饰器
reason: Detects returned nested wrapper functions forwarding a function parameter without functools.wraps; class decorators and indirect decorators require analysis.

title: G.FMT.03 合理安排空行--类内方法空1行
reason: Requires one blank line around direct class methods and nested classes when adjacent class-body statements exist; decorators stay attached to definitions.

title: G.DSP.01 将敏感对象发送出信任区域前进行签名并加密
reason: The export does not identify sensitive objects, trust boundaries, destinations or required signature/encryption schemes; these inputs must be supplied before a sound enforceable policy can be built.

title: G.CLS.02 子类重写父类的方法时，方法签名应该和被重写的方法一致
reason: Compares supplied-source inherited signatures using imports/reexports and C3 MRO, including positional-only and keyword-only defaults. Decorator-generated signatures, dynamic bases, overloads and full type variance remain unsupported.

title: G.FMT.08 一行只写一条语句--定义
reason: Checks function/class body statements sharing the declaration line.

title: G.CMT.04 代码的注释位置和格式应该在项目内保持统一
reason: Checks common comment-space and inline separation conventions; project-wide annotation formatting policies are not exported.

title: G.DSP.04 禁止在用户界面、日志中暴露不必要信息
reason: Flags common sensitive names in direct logging/print calls; actual disclosure necessity and data classification require context.

title: G.CLS.01 如果子类和父类中都有__init__方法，则子类中的__init__方法必须正确调用其父类__init__方法
reason: Resolves supplied-source imports and C3 inheritance; tracks initializer calls on bounded normal/return paths through branches, loops and finally, including shadowed super and receiver checks. Dynamic bases, framework initialization and complete exception/path feasibility remain unsupported.

title: G.FMT.08 一行只写一条语句--分号
reason: Detects semicolon operator tokens, excluding comments and strings.

title: G.PRM.03 资源的申请和释放需要成对使用，包括正常和异常场景
reason: Flags file acquisition outside with context management; balanced explicit cleanup, exceptional paths and other resource types require control-flow analysis.

title: G.CLS.11 避免在类外或者子类中访问父类受保护的成员
reason: Flags underscore-member access on non-self/cls receivers; inheritance, module privacy and documented friend APIs require type context.

title: G.FMT.03 合理安排空行--嵌套定义空1行

title: G.FMT.04 用空格突出关键字和重要信息
reason: Checks assignment/comparison operator spacing; complete keyword/default and continuation exceptions require formatting context.

title: G.CLS.08 避免在__init__方法外定义类实例属性
reason: Compares self stores against __init__ declarations within a class; inherited/dataclass/descriptor-generated attributes require type context.

title: G.FMT.03 合理安排空行--类间空2行
reason: Requires two blank lines on both sides of top-level function/class definitions when adjacent statements exist; decorators are part of the definition and file boundaries are exempt.

title: G.CLS.09 重写类的魔法函数时必须返回其原型指定的类型--getnewargs_ex
reason: Checks literal/protocol invariants and bounded supplied-source helper return facts, including implicit None, mixed returns and generator protocol mismatches. Dynamic calls, inherited protocols and complete control-flow/type inference remain unsupported.

title: G.FMT.01 程序块应该采用4个空格缩进风格编写
reason: Checks every syntactic INDENT increase is exactly four spaces and rejects tabs; continuation alignment and string/comment content are excluded by tokenize.

title: G.FIO.04 临时文件使用完毕应及时删除
reason: Flags NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False); explicit cleanup, exceptional paths and additional temporary APIs require lifetime analysis.

title: G.OPR.04 不建议使用海象运算符
reason: Detects assignment expressions using the AST NamedExpr node.

title: G.FMT.04 用空格突出关键字和重要信息--关键字后
reason: Checks separation after expression-leading/control Python keywords, including not, await and except-star syntax; block colons and punctuation are exempt.

title: G.CTL.04 建议使用 for x in iterable 的方式循环处理可迭代对象
reason: Flags range(len(...)) loops for direct-iteration review; legitimate use of indexes requires data-flow/context review.

title: G.EDV.08 防止正则表达式引起的ReDos攻击
reason: Parses literal regex structures for nested quantifiers; this is a review signal, not an exhaustive ReDoS complexity proof.

title: G.TYP.02 浮点型数据判断相等不要直接使用==
